plan.name: Isolate each configured acceptance invocation
plan.summary: Run each configured acceptance invocation, from discovery and helper compilation through evidence collection, in a fresh disposable container from the verified immutable prepared image and pristine staged base or candidate inputs, so earlier commands and selectors cannot supply its tools, startup hooks, files or caches. Preserve build outputs across a part's format, lint, build and suite commands in a separate container, omit empty command containers, and deliberately replace tests that pin one environment for commands and selectors or expect command-side framework deletion to affect acceptance. Keep captured policy, pinned sources, authentic evidence, serial process-tree ownership and queue ownership through bounded uncanceled cleanup, stop on startup or cleanup failure while retaining earlier evidence, and charge invocation staging and startup to the single shared test allowance without renewing the whole-run deadline. Add daemon-free and offline opt-in real Go and pytest attacks covering replaced interpreters/toolchains, poisoned caches and startup hooks, exercise base checks and candidate checks, and report reproducible per-invocation startup, staging, compilation and total costs against the current shared-container implementation using the same local pinned images. Update SPEC.md and docs/factory.md to describe the isolation, changed command-to-acceptance boundary, opt-ins and cost comparison with decision citations; the merger must record the issue's decided fresh-container policy, which is not yet in the journal, on the grounds of D-0108, D-0311, D-0316 and D-0352, while external intake and the unconfigured Go runner retain their current behavior.

tests.name: TestConfiguredInvocationIsolation621
tests.says: Commands retain their build outputs, but every configured selector discovers and executes in its own pristine environment, with captured policy and source bytes, on both the independent base and candidate paths.

tests.name: TestInvocationCleanupStopsLaterSelectors621
tests.says: A failed close of one invocation prevents the next selector from starting and preserves the first selector's authentic result under bounded uncanceled cleanup.

tests.name: TestInvocationStartupSharesTestAllowance621
tests.says: Opening each fresh selector environment consumes the original shared test allowance, and a later startup timeout retains earlier evidence and leaves later selectors unstarted.

tests.name: TestGoInvocationPristineInputs621
tests.says: Through the production Docker transport with a daemon-free boundary and real Go, an earlier selector cannot make a later selector pass by overwriting production inputs or leaving poisoned files in its build cache.

tests.name: TestInvocationOfflineImages621
tests.says: A mandatory daemon-free isolation control runs by default; the enabled offline real-image Go and pytest suite actually replaces toolchain or interpreter files, poisons caches and installs startup hooks, then obtains independent authentic later evidence without downloads.

usage.summary: Wrote plan.json and five acceptance tests covering invocation isolation, cleanup, shared deadlines, and attack scenarios. Check 1 passed: all five tests fail on the unchanged base; the change requires a person to merge it.
